artigo.titulo: Why are my houseplant's leaf tips turning brown?

legenda: Brown leaf tips won't turn green again, but they tell you what to change. Dry air, thirsty soil, fertiliser salts or soggy roots: new leaves can come through whole.

beats.texto: Brown tips?! I'm not dying, I'm telling you something!
Relax! It's usually one of three things.
Dry air from the heating crisps the tips.
Or the soil stayed bone dry for days.
White crust on the soil?! Fertiliser salts. Flush them out.
But here's the thing. Soggy soil causes brown tips too!
So check the soil first, and water deeply once it's dry.
Every plant is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
